# Functions
```{r functions, include = FALSE}
# convert power in uV^2 to dB
uV2_to_dB <- function(uV2){
  dB <- 10*log10(uV2)
}

# outlier detection of lmer models
outlier_modelresiduals <- function(df, model_residuals, var2clean){
  # z-score residuals
  residuals_z <- scale(model_residuals)[,1]
  # new column name
  newcolname <- paste0(var2clean,"_clean")
  # outlier variables to NA
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      !!newcolname := if_else(
        abs(residuals_z)>2 | is.na(residuals_z),
        NA,
        .data[[var2clean]])
    )
  # remove outlier rows
  df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(!!sym(newcolname)))
  return(df)
}

# rename only the non-merge columns
rename_data_cols <- function(df, suffix) {
  data_cols <- setdiff(names(df), merge_cols)
  names(df)[names(df) %in% data_cols] <- paste0(data_cols, "_", suffix)
  df
}
```

# Load and clean data
```{r load data, include=FALSE}
# --- where to save model fits ---
savedir <- '/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/R/mainpaper/'

# --- shared columns to merge on ---
merge_cols <- c("lunaid","eeg_date","eeg_age","sex","PercentErrCor",
                "Accuracy","AvgLatCor","CVLatCor","AvgLatErrCor","CVLatErrCor",
                "NumCor","NumErrCor","NumIncor","NumDrop","Total","Viable")

# --- ERSP cluster data ---
# load data from cluster power/ersp table
clusterpower_frow_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/ersp_itc_clusters_avgtrl_frow_20260508.csv')
clusterpower_prow_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/ersp_itc_clusters_avgtrl_prow_20260615.csv')

# Adding f-row to column names
clusterpower_frow_df <- rename_data_cols(clusterpower_frow_df, "frow")
clusterpower_prow_df <- rename_data_cols(clusterpower_prow_df, "prow")

# combine cluster power frow and prow
clusterpower_df <- merge(clusterpower_frow_df, clusterpower_prow_df, by = merge_cols)

# cluster description data frames 
clusters_frow_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/ersp_itc_clusterinfo_avgtrl_frow_20260508.csv')
clusters_prow_df <- read.csv("/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/ersp_itc_clusterinfo_avgtrl_prow_20260615.csv")
clusters_frow_df$row <- as.factor('frow')
clusters_prow_df$row <- as.factor('prow')
clusters_df <- rbind(clusters_frow_df, clusters_prow_df)

# --- Broadband spontaneous and evoked power data ---
# broadband spontaneous and evoked power
broadband_frow_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/broadband_sponevo_frow_20260508.csv') # f-row
broadband_prow_df <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Abby/AS_EEG/Results/broadband_sponevo_prow_20260615.csv') # p-row
# renamed only non-merge columns
broadband_frow_df <- rename_data_cols(broadband_frow_df,"frow")
broadband_prow_df <- rename_data_cols(broadband_prow_df,"prow")
# merge broadband dataframes
broadband_df <- merge(broadband_frow_df, broadband_prow_df, by = merge_cols)

# --- Combine ERSP and braodband spon/evo power ---
# merge broadband and ersp data frames
sponevo_ersp_df <- merge(clusterpower_df,broadband_df, by = merge_cols)

# make lunaid a factor
sponevo_ersp_df$lunaid <- as.factor(sponevo_ersp_df$lunaid)

# add visit number
sponevo_ersp_df <- sponevo_ersp_df %>%
  group_by(lunaid) %>%
  mutate(visit = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# calculate correct response rate
sponevo_ersp_df$CorRate <- sponevo_ersp_df$NumCor / (sponevo_ersp_df$NumCor +
                                                               sponevo_ersp_df$NumErrCor)

# columns to not convert to dB
cols_no_convert <- c("lunaid","eeg_date","eeg_age","sex",
                     "PercentErrCor","AvgLatCor","CVLatCor",
                     "AvgLatErrCor","CVLatErrCor","NumCor",
                     "NumErrCor","NumDrop","NumIncor","Total",
                     "Viable","visit","CorRate","Accuracy","CorRate")

# columns to convert to dB
cols_to_convert <- sponevo_ersp_df %>%
  dplyr::select(contains("power"), -all_of(cols_no_convert)) %>%
  names()

# convert power values from uV^2 to dB
sponevo_ersp_df_dB <- sponevo_ersp_df %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(cols_to_convert),
      .fns = ~ uV2_to_dB(.x),
      .names = "{.col}_dB"
    )
  )

# --- Define main data frame ---
main_df <- sponevo_ersp_df_dB

# make sure dB matrix lunaid is factor
main_df$lunaid <- factor(main_df$lunaid, levels = levels(main_df$lunaid))

# Calculate inverse age
main_df$invage <- 1/main_df$eeg_age

# Make sex a categorical variable
main_df$sex <- as.factor(main_df$sex)

# Filter out non-viable subs
main_df_viable <- main_df %>% filter(Viable==1)

# Calculate spontaneous/ evoked difference (AS - VGS) and ersp cluster differences (AS - VGS)
main_df_viable <- main_df_viable %>%
  mutate(
    # F-row spon/evo
    diff_broadband_spon_frow = corAS_broadband_sponpower_frow_dB -
      VGS_broadband_sponpower_frow_dB,
    diff_broadband_evo_frow = corAS_broadband_evopower_frow_dB - 
      VGS_broadband_evopower_frow_dB,
    # P-row spon/evo
    diff_broadband_spon_prow = corAS_broadband_sponpower_prow_dB -
      VGS_broadband_evopower_frow_dB,
    diff_broadband_evo_prow = corAS_broadband_evopower_prow_dB -
      VGS_broadband_evopower_prow_dB,
    # F-row ERSP
    diff_c1_ersp_frow = corAS_c1_ersp_interaction_frow - VGS_c1_ersp_interaction_frow,
    diff_c2_ersp_frow = corAS_c2_ersp_interaction_frow - VGS_c2_ersp_interaction_frow,
    diff_c3_ersp_frow = corAS_c3_ersp_interaction_frow - VGS_c3_ersp_interaction_frow,
    diff_c4_ersp_frow = corAS_c4_ersp_interaction_frow - VGS_c4_ersp_interaction_frow,
    diff_c5_ersp_frow = corAS_c5_ersp_interaction_frow - VGS_c5_ersp_interaction_frow,
    # P-row ERSP
    diff_c1_ersp_prow = corAS_c1_ersp_interaction_prow - VGS_c1_ersp_interaction_prow,
    diff_c2_ersp_prow = corAS_c2_ersp_interaction_prow - VGS_c2_ersp_interaction_prow,
    diff_c3_ersp_prow = corAS_c3_ersp_interaction_prow - VGS_c3_ersp_interaction_prow,
    diff_c4_ersp_prow = corAS_c4_ersp_interaction_prow - VGS_c4_ersp_interaction_prow,
    diff_c5_ersp_prow = corAS_c5_ersp_interaction_prow - VGS_c5_ersp_interaction_prow,
    diff_c6_ersp_prow = corAS_c6_ersp_interaction_prow - VGS_c6_ersp_interaction_prow
  )

# define age categories and make a factor
main_df_viable <- main_df_viable %>% mutate(
  age_cat = ifelse(
    eeg_age < 17,"kid",
    ifelse(
      eeg_age>=23,
      "adult",
      'adolescent'
    )
  )
)
main_df_viable$age_cat <- factor(main_df_viable$age_cat, 
                                 levels = c("kid","adolescent","adult"))
```

# Demographic information
```{r}
demo_info <- read_excel("/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/txt/7T_packet.xlsx", sheet = "Demographics")
demo_info <- demo_info %>%
  mutate(
    lunaid = as.factor(
      sub("\\.0$","",
          sub(";.","",ID))
    )
  ) %>% group_by(lunaid) %>%
  mutate(
    visit = row_number()
  ) %>% ungroup()

demo_info_first <- demo_info %>% filter(visit == 1)

# matching ids
demo_info_ids <- unique(demo_info_first$lunaid)
main_df_ASeeg_ids <- unique(main_df_ASeeg$lunaid)

keep_idx <- demo_info_first$lunaid %in% main_df_ASeeg_ids

# filtered eeg df, only people who are in demo_info
demo_info_filt <- demo_info_first[keep_idx, ]

race_cols <- c("hispanic","american_indian","asian","black","hawaiian","white","unspecified")
race_mat <- as.matrix(demo_info_filt[, race_cols])
race_mat <- race_mat == "TRUE"
n_checked <- rowSums(race_mat, na.rm=T)

demo_info_filt$race_cat <- ifelse(
  n_checked > 1, "multi",
  ifelse(n_checked==0,"unspecified",
         race_cols[apply(race_mat,1, function(x) which(x)[1])])
)

tab <- table(demo_info_filt$race_cat)
round(100 * tab / sum(tab), 1)

```

# Behavior
## Age + Sex
```{r behavior age effects, echo = FALSE}
# variables to loop over
behavs <- c("CorRate","CVLatCor","AvgLatCor")

for (b in behavs){
  # define temporary data frame
  temp_df <- data.frame(
    behav = main_df_viable[[b]],
    lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
    eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
    invage = main_df_viable$invage,
    eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
    sex = main_df_viable$sex
  )
  # --- Inverse Age ---
  # lm model with no random effects
  lm_model <- lm(behav ~ invage + sex,
                 data = temp_df,
                 na.action = na.exclude)
  clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df, 
                                     residuals(lm_model),
                                     "lunaid")
  lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(behav ~ invage + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                               data = clean_df,
                               na.action = na.exclude)
  # print summary
  lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
  print(b)
  print(lmer_summary)
  
  # --- Linear Age ---
  # lm model with no random effects
  lm_model_linage <- lm(behav ~ eeg_age + sex,
                 data = temp_df,
                 na.action = na.exclude)
  clean_df_linage <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df, 
                                     residuals(lm_model_linage),
                                     "lunaid")
  lmer_model_linage <- lmerTest::lmer(behav ~ eeg_age + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                               data = clean_df_linage,
                               na.action = na.exclude)
  # print AICs
  print(paste("AIC (inverse age):",round(AIC(lmer_model),2)))
  print(paste("AIC (linear age):",round(AIC(lmer_model_linage),2)))
  
  # bundle of variables to save
  model_bundle <- list(
    model = lmer_model,
    coefs = as.data.frame(coef(lmer_summary)),
    cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
    origdata = lm_model$model,
    AIC_invage = AIC(lmer_model),
    AIC_linage = AIC(lmer_model_linage),
    BIC_invage = BIC(lmer_model),
    BIC_linage = BIC(lmer_model_linage)
  )
  # save results
  savename <- paste0(savedir,b,"_Age_Effects.rds")
  saveRDS(model_bundle, file = savename)
}

```

# Spontaneous and Evoked power
## Age * Condition + Sex effects
```{r spon/evo age effects, echo = FALSE}
# variables to loop over
powertypes <- c("spon","evo")
rows <- c("frow","prow")

for (p in powertypes){
  for (r in rows){
    # define temporary data frame
    temp_df <- data.frame(
      lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
      eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
      invage = main_df_viable$invage,
      eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
      sex = main_df_viable$sex,
      ASpower = main_df_viable[[paste0("corAS_broadband_",p,"power_", r,"_dB")]],
      VGSpower = main_df_viable[[paste0("VGS_broadband_",p,"power_", r,"_dB")]],
      diffpower = main_df_viable[[paste0("diff_broadband_",p,"_",r)]]
      )
    # pivot long
    temp_df_long <- pivot_longer(temp_df, cols = c("ASpower","VGSpower"),
                                 names_to = "condition",
                                 values_to = "power")
    temp_df_long$condition <- as.factor(temp_df_long$condition)
    # lm model
    lm_model <- lm(power ~ condition * invage + sex ,
                   data = temp_df_long,
                   na.action = na.exclude)
    clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df_long,
                                       residuals(lm_model),
                                       "lunaid")
    lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(power ~ condition * invage + sex +
                                   (1|lunaid_clean),
                                 data = clean_df,
                                 na.action = na.exclude)
    
    # print summary 
    lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
    print(paste(p,r))
    print(lmer_summary)
    
    # bundle and save results
    model_bundle <- list(
      model = lmer_model,
      coefs = as.data.frame(coef(lmer_summary)),
      cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
      origdata =  lm_model$model
    )
    savename <- paste0(savedir,p,"Power",r, "_AgeCondition_Effects.rds")
    saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
    
  }
  
}

```

## Behavior effects: F-row
```{r spon/evo behavior effects, echo=FALSE}
# variables to loop over
powertypes <- c("spon","evo")
rows <- c("frow")
tasks <- c("corAS","VGS")
behavs <- c("CorRate","CVLatCor","AvgLatCor")

for (p in powertypes){
  for (r in rows){
    for (t in tasks){
      for (b in behavs){
        temp_df <- data.frame(
          lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
          eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
          invage = main_df_viable$invage,
          eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
          sex = main_df_viable$sex,
          power = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_broadband_",p,"power_",r,"_dB")]],
          behav = main_df_viable[[b]]
          )
        # lm model
        lm_model <- lm(behav ~ power + invage + sex,
                       data = temp_df,
                       na.action = na.exclude)
        clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df,
                                           residuals(lm_model),
                                           "lunaid")
        lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(behav ~ power + invage + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                                     data = clean_df,
                                     na.action = na.exclude)
        # print summary
        lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
        lmer_coefs <- coef(lmer_summary)
        print(paste(p,r,t,b))
        print(lmer_coefs)
        
        # bundle and save results
        model_bundle <- list(
          model = lmer_model,
          coefs = as.data.frame(lmer_coefs),
          cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
          origdata = lm_model$model
        )
        savename <- paste0(savedir,b,"_", t, p, "Power",r, "_Effects.rds")
        saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
        
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# ERSP clusters
## Behavior: F-row
```{r ersp behavior effect, echo = FALSE}
# variables to loop over
tasks <- c("corAS","VGS")
behavs <- c("CorRate","CVLatCor","AvgLatCor")
modelterm <- "interaction"
datatype <- "ersp"

for (t in tasks){
  for (b in behavs){
    temp_df <- data.frame(
      lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
      eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
      eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
      invage = main_df_viable$invage,
      sex = main_df_viable$sex,
      c1 = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_c1_ersp_",modelterm,"_frow")]],
      c2 = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_c2_ersp_",modelterm,"_frow")]],
      c3 = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_c3_ersp_",modelterm,"_frow")]],
      c4 = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_c4_ersp_",modelterm,"_frow")]],
      c5 = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_c5_ersp_",modelterm,"_frow")]],
      behav = main_df_viable[[b]]
    )
    
    # lm model 
    lm_model <- lm(behav ~ invage + sex + c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5, 
                   data = temp_df,
                   na.action = na.exclude)
    clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df,
                                       residuals(lm_model),
                                       "lunaid")
    lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(behav ~ invage +  sex + c1 + c2 + c3 + c4 + c5 + (1|lunaid_clean),
                                 data = clean_df,
                                 na.action = na.exclude)
    # print summary
    lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
    lmer_coefs <- coef(lmer_summary)
    print(paste(t,b))
    print(lmer_summary)
    # bundle and save 
    model_bundle <- list(
      model = lmer_model,
      coefs = as.data.frame(lmer_coefs),
      cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
      origdata = lm_model$model
    )
    savename <- paste0(savedir,b,"_",t,"frowERSPclusters_Effect.rds")
    saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
  }
}
```

# Spon/evo power and ERSP clusters
## Power ~ Age * ERSP: F-row
```{r power ~ age*ersp, echo=FALSE}
# variables to loop over
tasks <- c("corAS","VGS")
powertypes <- c("spon","evo")
clusters <- c(1,5)
modelterm <- "interaction"

for (p in powertypes){
  for (C in clusters){
    currcluster <- paste0("cluster",C)
    for (t in tasks){
      temp_df <- data.frame(
        lunaid = main_df_viable$lunaid,
        eeg_date = main_df_viable$eeg_date,
        eeg_age = main_df_viable$eeg_age,
        invage = main_df_viable$invage,
        sex = main_df_viable$sex,
        ersp = main_df_viable[[paste0(t,"_c",C,"_ersp_",modelterm,"_frow")]],
        power = main_df_viable[[paste0("corAS_broadband_",p,"power_frow_dB")]]
        )
      # run model
      lm_model <- lm(power~invage*ersp + sex,
                     data = temp_df,
                     na.action = na.exclude)
      clean_df <- outlier_modelresiduals(temp_df,
                                         residuals(lm_model),
                                         "lunaid")
      lmer_model <- lmerTest::lmer(power~invage*ersp + sex + (1|lunaid_clean),
                                   data = clean_df,
                                   na.action = na.exclude)
      # print results
      lmer_summary <- summary(lmer_model)
      lmer_coefs <- coef(lmer_summary)
      print(paste(p,C,t))
      print(lmer_summary)

      # save results
      model_bundle <- list(
        model = lmer_model,
        coefs = as.data.frame(lmer_coefs),
        cleandata = lmer_model@frame,
        origdata = lm_model$model
      )
      savename <- paste0(savedir,
                         t,p,"Power","_",currcluster,"ERSPfrow_Effect.rds")
      saveRDS(model_bundle,savename)
    }
  }
}

```
